_comment: Copy this file to camera_sources.json (same folder) and fill in your camera. camera_sources.json is gitignored because it holds the camera password. Each key below must match a camera id in the app (see the Camera dropdown / + Add Camera). Test a camera first with: python3 scripts/test_camera.py <address> --user <name>  (and --brands for common addresses).

_examples._comment: Not used as-is: copy one out to the top level and rename it to your camera's id.

_options.type: reolink (default if left out) | rtsp | http_snapshot
_options.rtsp_url: the camera's full-resolution stream; a login typed into it is moved out automatically
_options.live_rtsp_url: optional smaller stream just for the Live View popup
_options.rtsp_decode: keyframes (default: light on CPU, a picture every 1-4 s) | all (use if the camera sends key frames rarely)
_options.interval_seconds: how often to check the spaces (default 3)
